name: PgBouncer 1.26 with PostgreSQL 18
description: Postgres 18 behind a PgBouncer connection pool, private and ready to use.

PORT.description: Private healthcheck port (GET /healthz). Not the database port.

DATABASE_URL.description: Pooled connection URL for your apps: reference ${{PgBouncer.DATABASE_URL}}.

POSTGRES_HOST.description: Postgres host PgBouncer pools (private network). Point it at another Railway Postgres to pool that one.

AUTH_USER.description: Postgres superuser PgBouncer uses to look up client passwords (auth_query) and for the admin console.

PGBOUNCER_POOL_MODE.description: transaction (most apps, prepared statements supported), session (apps that need session state, e.g. LISTEN/NOTIFY, advisory locks) or statement.

PGBOUNCER_MIN_POOL_SIZE.description: Server connections kept open even when idle.

PGBOUNCER_RESERVE_POOL_SIZE.description: Extra connections allowed when clients wait longer than 3 s.

PGBOUNCER_MAX_DB_CONNECTIONS.description: Upper limit of server connections per database (keep below Postgres max_connections, 100 by default). 0 = no limit.

PGBOUNCER_MAX_CLIENT_CONN.description: Client connections PgBouncer accepts in total.

PGBOUNCER_MAX_PREPARED_STATEMENTS.description: Prepared statements tracked per connection in transaction mode (0 = off).

PGBOUNCER_SERVER_IDLE_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds before an idle server connection is closed.

PGBOUNCER_QUERY_WAIT_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds a query may wait for a free server connection before the client gets an error.

PGBOUNCER_CLIENT_TLS.description: TLS for clients: allow (TLS if the client asks, self-signed certificate), require (TLS only, use with a TCP proxy) or disable.

PGBOUNCER_SERVER_TLS.description: TLS from PgBouncer to Postgres (disable on Railway's private network; prefer/require for external hosts).

PGDATA.description: Location where the database will be initialized.

PGUSER.description: User for the Railway Data panel.

PGDATABASE.description: Database for the Railway Data panel.

PGPASSWORD.description: Password for the Railway Data panel.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Default database created when the image first starts.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private connection URL for other services in this project.

POSTGRES_USER.description: Superuser created when the image first starts.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Allow Postgres to shut down cleanly.
